articles.title: BrahMos missile system to undergo 'simulation firing' in 'Balikatan'
articles.summary: The Indian-made BrahMos cruise missile system, hailed as the Philippines' most powerful weapon, is slated for deployment. This significant acquisition bolsters the Philippine arsenal, underscoring a critical defence collaboration between India and the Philippines. The system enhances the nation's security capabilities and reflects strengthening strategic partnerships, particularly vital for regional stability in the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: LAUNCH OF DSC A 23 (YARD 328) - FOURTH SHIP OF DIVING SUPPORT CRAFT (DSC) PROJECT
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence launched DSC A 23 on April 19, 2026, marking the fourth ship in a crucial five-vessel Diving Support Craft (DSC) project. These indigenous crafts are vital for the Indian Navy's underwater operations, maintenance, and rescue missions, significantly bolstering its operational readiness and self-reliance in defence infrastructure.
